summary: Shows host vars for certificate auth with psrp and winrm (paths to public and private PEM files), the PowerShell command to enable certificate auth, and notes the private key must be unencrypted and TLS 1.3 requirements.
questions: What inventory variables configure WinRM certificate auth?
How do I enable certificate authentication on the WinRM service?
What do I need for certificate auth over TLS 1.3?

answer_card.title: Configuring certificate auth in Ansible
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
# psrp
ansible_connection: psrp
ansible_psrp_auth: certificate
ansible_psrp_certificate_pem: /path/public_key.pem
ansible_psrp_certificate_key_pem: /path/private_key.pem
# winrm
ansible_connection: winrm
ansible_winrm_transport: certificate
ansible_winrm_cert_pem: /path/public_key.pem
ansible_winrm_cert_key_pem: /path/private_key.pem
```

Enable on the host: `Set-Item -Path WSMan:\localhost\Service\Auth\Certificate -Value $true`

The private key must be unencrypted. TLS 1.3 needs Python 3.8+ (or 3.7.1 / 3.6.7) and urllib3>=2.0.7.
